display.purpose: Page titles, stat-tile numerals, card titles.

body.purpose: All functional UI text — labels, buttons, tables, forms.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for every card, stat tile, and table shell.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and reveal transitions only — never idle/decorative.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single commit action per view — Approve & send, Create entry, Save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2F6F62; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 100ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2a6357; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2F6F62; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Status and tenant badges — always visible so the coach knows a send's origin at a glance.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; background: #E4EEEB; color: #2F6F62; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: Top-of-view KPI block — a tinted icon ring, a large tabular number, a small label.
components.css: .ds-stat-tile { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #DFDDD6; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06); } .ds-stat-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #F2F1ED; color: #5B6763; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; font-size: 30px; color: #1F2623; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin: 0; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 12px; color: #5B6763; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Icon + label sidebar row; active item gets a teal-tinted background.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(204,214,210,0.8); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: rgba(111,184,165,0.15); color: #6FB8A5; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: CoachFlow is a daily-use operations tool for an executive coach, not a marketing surface — a single practitioner scanning what needs attention across two client tenants before their next session. The system reads as a modern SaaS admin dashboard: a fixed dark sidebar anchors navigation, a paper-toned content field holds elevated white (or dark-surface) cards, and a KPI strip leads every main view so the coach sees counts before they scroll. The palette stays the practice's own — warm paper, deep teal, and an amber reserved strictly for needs attention — carried into a denser, card-first structure rather than the flat top-nav lists the app shipped with originally. Density and restraint govern every decision here: this is Operate mode, so familiarity beats expression.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed dark sidebar, collapsing to an icon rail at tablet width, a slide-over drawer on mobile.
Elevated white/dark-surface cards on a warm paper field, never a bare list or table row.
Amber is exclusively the pending/attention signal.
Teal is exclusively the primary action/positive-state signal.
Fraunces is reserved for headings and large numerals; everything else is Public Sans.

rules.name: The Amber Exclusivity Rule
rules.body: Amber never appears for anything except something the coach must act on.

rules.name: The Sidebar-Stays-Dark Rule
rules.body: The sidebar ground never follows the light/dark toggle.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every column of numbers uses tabular-nums so digits align.

rules.name: The Hover-Raises Rule
rules.body: A card only escalates from card to cardmd shadow in direct response to hover/focus.

dos: Do reserve amber strictly for pending/attention states.
Do keep the sidebar ground dark in both light and dark theme.
Do show a countdown or status chip's meaning as visible text, not color alone.
Do use tabular-nums on every numeric column.
Do raise a card's shadow only in direct response to hover/focus.
donts: Don't use a colored left/right border as a callout or emphasis device.
Don't introduce a second display face or a system font as the heading voice.
Don't ship a stat tile, pill, or button that skips the shared component.
